summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. Tests pass: 41 passed across the new module and test/test_path.py, run with the prepared venv's Python. Nothing committed; no other files changed. Unverified: mypy, ruff, black and isort are not installed in the venv, so the type-check gate and formatters were not run. Type-ignore placement and 88-column limits were checked by reading only. One uncertain spot: the pytest.raises(expected) line has no type-ignore, which may be unused under warn_unused_ignores; add an arg-type ignore there if the checker reports it. Non-node inputs (None, plain string) are tested in a separate second test function.
